findings.title: Health First Medical Group outpatient sites temporarily closed amid Brevard County flooding
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Health First Medical Group has closed all of its locations Monday morning due to severe weather in Brevard County
findings.service_line: Outpatient medical group / primary care; clinical laboratories; pharmacy
findings.access_consequences: Local news reported that Health First Medical Group closed all locations on November 2 morning because of flooding. Malabar, Eldron and Indialantic labs remained closed and Family Pharmacy openings were delayed. Reopening of the medical group was tentative for the afternoon; the source did not verify whether locations had reopened at observation. No hospital or ED closure is asserted.
findings.affected_population: Health First Medical Group patients and users of the named lab/pharmacy locations in Brevard County, Florida; number of patients affected not reported.
findings.source_headline: Brevard Public Schools cancels Tuesday classes amid heavy flooding
findings.qualification_note: Late-discovered same-day access interruption. The article was initially published at 06:43 ET (before the prior hourly observation window) but updated at 17:16 ET / 14:16 PST (inside it), and the disruption is not in the immediately preceding verified heartbeat. The update time does not establish that this particular closure paragraph was added or first reported within the window. Verify reopening and production deduplication before any editorial use.
